name: Boba
thesis: A bubble-tea truck as a Y2K pastel candy site: one full-page pink→lavender→sky gradient with two blurred blob shapes morphing behind everything, frosted-glass cards floating on top, 999px pills everywhere, and a single hot-pink→violet gradient doing every accent job — wordmark suffix, H1 text clip, selected chips, prices, CTAs. No heritage copy at all: freshness plus build-it-yourself agency ('sealed and shaken to order') IS the brand, and the page's centerpiece is a live drink configurator, not a story band.

tokens.bg: linear-gradient(160deg, #FFE1F1 0%, #E9E1FF 46%, #DDF3FF 100%) full-page pastel gradient; two absolutely-positioned morphing blobs behind the content (rgba(255,138,197,0.4) left, rgba(138,180,255,0.4) right, blur(6px)); frosted surfaces rgba(255,255,255,0.55–0.82) with backdrop-blur 10–12px; the configurator rail tints linear-gradient(160deg,#F6EFFF,#FFEFF8)
tokens.fg: #3A2B52 deep plum primary; #5C4B76 secondary; #6A5A82 nav/footer; #7C6C92 descriptions; #9A8AB0 / #8A7BA0 muted labels + mono hours
tokens.accent: #FF4FA3 hot pink, almost always worn as the gradient linear-gradient(120deg,#FF4FA3,#8A6BFF); #8A6BFF violet is the second stop and #4FB8FF sky joins only in the 3-stop H1 clip; softer tints #FF6FB5 (wordmark suffix) and #FFB6DA/#B7A6FF (hero blob) support
tokens.fontDisplay: var(--font-sans) at weight 800 with literal px sizes — h1 60px/0.98 (-0.02em), h2 34px, wordmark 21px; no serif anywhere; body rides var(--text-sm)/var(--text-xl) scale tokens
tokens.fontMono: var(--font-mono) used exactly twice — the schedule hours column (var(--text-sm), #8A7BA0) and the tiny demo-folio footer line — a quiet ticket-stub tell against the bubbly sans
tokens.radius: 999px pills dominate (chips, buttons, badges, cart pill); cards step down by importance: configurator shell 26px, menu/schedule cards 20px, summary card 16px, add-to-order button 14px, glyph tile 11px
tokens.border: 1px solid #fff on every frosted card (glass reads as a lit pane on the pastel wash); 1.5px solid #E7DCF7 pale lilac on unselected chips; 1px dashed #E7DCF7 divider above the price; schedule rows split by rgba(231,220,247,0.7) hairlines
tokens.motion: One border-radius morph keyframe (42% 58% 63% 37% ↔ 58% 42% 37% 63%) shared by both background blobs and the hero emoji blob at staggered 9s/10s/11s ease-in-out infinite; chips swap to the gradient via transition: all .15s; CTAs lift translateY(-1px) with a violet glow shadow; all of it drops under prefers-reduced-motion

layout: Single column capped at 1120px with 30px side padding, sitting on the full-viewport pastel gradient (overflow:hidden on the root so the negative blob offsets never cause horizontal scroll; blobs behind a z-index:1 content layer). A frosted sticky header (rgba white 0.55 + blur 12px, z-index 20 under the gallery chrome) carries the wordmark + gradient sub-brand and a 3-link section nav. The hero is a 1fr/1fr grid — badge pill, 60px gradient-clipped H1, lede, two pill CTAs on the left; a 230px morphing gradient blob holding a 96px 🧋 emoji on the right. Below it the page's centerpiece: one big glass card split 1fr/320px — four chip-groups left, a tinted summary rail right ('Your cup' white card + gradient add-to-order bar). Then a centered-heading 3×2 grid of frosted menu cards, a six-row schedule ticket in one glass card, and a translucent white footer strip. Density is airy — 24–50px section padding, pill-heavy spacing.

sections.name: sticky header
sections.what: Frosted-glass bar: 'Mom-n-Pops' wordmark (800/21px) plus a gradient-text 'Boba ✦' suffix linking to the collection hub, right-aligned nav (Build a drink / Menu / Find us) that smooth-scrolls via refs, and a white '🧋 n' order pill that appears after the first add.
sections.restyle: Restyled Navbar: the <nav> shell is stripped of its px/bg/border defaults and repainted as the frosted glass bar — rgba(255,255,255,0.55) + backdrop-blur(12px) + 1px rgba-white bottom border, sticky under the gallery frame (z-index 20, top offset clearing it); its inner flex wrapper carries the 1120px max-width + 30px padding. Navbar.Brand holds the Inertia Link lockup (sub-brand is background-clip:text on the pink→violet gradient with a solid pink fallback); Navbar.Items is forced always-visible (no Navbar.Toggle) and holds the three section-jump <button>s (scrollIntoView on refs — no window/document reads) plus the order-count Badge. The '🧋 n' pill is a Badge flattened to a white hot-pink glow pill.

sections.name: hero
sections.what: 1fr/1fr grid. Left: '✦ SHAKEN FRESH · MILWAUKEE · 2026 ✦' pill, the 60px gradient H1 'Boba, built your way.', a 420px lede about real brewed tea and sealed-to-order shaking, and two pill CTAs (gradient 'Build a drink ✦' + white 'See favorites') that jump to their sections. Right: a 230px pink→periwinkle blob morphing on the shared keyframe with a 96px 🧋 emoji centered in it — the emoji IS the product shot.
sections.restyle: Badge flattened to the white sparkle pill: 12px/800, 0.06em tracking, radius 999, no border, pink text, pink glow shadow. Buttons become candy pills (radius 999, 13px/24px padding): primary wears the pink→violet gradient + violet glow 0 10px 24px -8px rgba(138,107,255,0.7), secondary is plain white with plum text. The H1 runs the only 3-stop gradient clip (#FF4FA3→#8A6BFF→#4FB8FF) with a pink fallback color.

sections.name: build-your-boba configurator
sections.what: THE special surface: one glass card (radius 26, blur 10, white 1px border, big violet shadow) split 1fr/320px. Left: a gradient ✦ glyph tile + 'Build-your-boba / tap the options — it mixes as you go', then four single-select chip groups — Tea base (4), Milk (3), Sweetness (5), Topping (5). Right: a tinted rail holding a white 'Your cup' card (derived name 'base ✦ topping', description 'milk · sweetness sweet', gradient-clipped live price over a dashed divider), a full-width gradient 'Add to order · $X.XX' button, and a fading '✦ Added — n cups in your order' aria-live flash.
sections.restyle: The outer Card and inner summary Card go glass/white with forced radii; every option chip is a react-fancy Button squeezed to a 999px pill (1.5px lilac border, white fill, .15s transition) whose data-on='true' state flips to the gradient with white text — declarative selected styling, NOT the mockup's imperative DOM repaint. State is one {base,milk,sweet,top} object; the price lives in a single priceFor() ($5 base, +$0.75 brown-sugar/popping boba, +$1 cheese foam, +$0.50 taro/matcha) shared by the summary, the button label, and any future configure_drink bridge. Chips carry stable data-group/data-opt handles so an agent can drive the builder without guessing DOM.

sections.name: house favorites
sections.what: Centered 34px 'Or a house favorite' heading over a 3×2 grid of frosted cards: name + flat-pink price on one baseline row, one-line description (Brown Sugar Milk Tea $6 → Mango Green Tea $6).
sections.restyle: Cards forced to rgba(255,255,255,0.82) with 1px solid #fff borders and radius 20; hover lifts 3px into a soft violet shadow. Prices are flat #FF4FA3 here — the gradient is reserved for the configurator's live price so the centerpiece stays the loudest number on the page.

sections.name: find the truck
sections.what: One glass card of six rows — bold day, plum place, mono hours — covering the Tue–Sun Milwaukee route (Marquette → Bay View), rows split by faint lilac hairlines.
sections.restyle: Restyled Table (literal tabular data): the Table's outer wrapper becomes the frosted glass card (rgba white 0.82 + 1px #fff border + radius 20, its default border/rounded/overflow overridden), and each Stop is a real <tr> of day / place / hours cells — headerless, with the Table's divide-y row borders + hover fill neutralized so the only separators are the lilac hairlines on the cells. Day cell is fixed 130px/700 plum, place flexes, and the hours cell shrinks to content in var(--font-mono) at var(--text-sm) #8A7BA0 — the page's single typographic contrast, a ticket-stub read against the bubbly sans.

sections.name: footer
sections.what: Translucent white strip (rgba 0.6): brand 'Mom-n-Pops Boba ✦', scrape-obfuscated email (hello@momnpops.truck) + Instagram handle, '© 2026 · Milwaukee'; below it a tiny mono demo-folio line and a pink '← Back to the trucks' link.
sections.restyle: Flat flex space-between rows, all hand-rolled; the ✦ sparkle motif closes the page in the wordmark.

palette.restyle: The frosted sticky header. The <nav> shell's default px-4/py-3, bg-white, and bottom border are all stripped and repainted to the glass bar (rgba(255,255,255,0.55) + backdrop-blur(12px) + 1px rgba-white border, sticky at z-index 20 under the gallery frame, with an @supports solid fallback); padding + the 1120px max-width move onto the inner flex wrapper. Navbar.Brand carries the Inertia Link lockup; Navbar.Items is forced display:flex !important (overriding its `hidden md:flex` default, since there is no Navbar.Toggle) so the section links + order Badge never disappear on mobile.

Three reads, all candy: (1) hero CTAs — 999px pills, 13px/24px padding, primary in the pink→violet gradient with a violet glow + hover lift, secondary plain white with plum text; (2) option chips — the workhorse: 9px/15px pill, 1.5px lilac border, white fill, 600 weight, transition all .15s, and a data-on='true' repaint to the full gradient with white text and a soft glow; (3) the add-to-order bar — full-width, radius 14, gradient fill, tabular-nums price in the label.

Two flattened-pill reads: (1) the hero status pill — solid white, hot-pink 12px/800 text with 0.06em tracking, radius 999, zero border, and a pink glow shadow 0 6px 16px -6px rgba(255,79,163,0.6); (2) the header '🧋 n' order-count pill — the same white hot-pink glow pill at 13px/800 with 4px/12px padding. Both override Badge's soft-zinc chip + md padding with !important.

Three glass weights by importance: configurator shell rgba(255,255,255,0.7) + blur(10px) + 1px #fff border + radius 26 + 0 20px 50px -24px violet shadow; the six menu-favorite cards rgba 0.82 + radius 20 (no blur needed at that opacity) with a 3px hover lift; the 'Your cup' summary solid #fff + radius 16 + soft violet shadow. Always pair backdrop-filter with an @supports solid fallback.

The 'Find the truck' schedule — literal tabular data. The Table's outer wrapper is repainted as the frosted glass ticket (rgba white 0.82 + 1px #fff border + radius 20, overriding its default zinc border/rounded-lg), and each Stop is a headerless <tr> of day / place / hours cells. The divide-y row borders + hover fill are neutralized so only the lilac cell hairlines separate rows; the day cell is a fixed 130px/700 plum, place flexes, and the hours cell shrinks to content in var(--font-mono)/var(--text-sm) #8A7BA0.
Brand lockup (plum wordmark + gradient-clipped suffix, seated inside Navbar.Brand) and the pink footer back-link — nav jumps are buttons, not anchors, so the SPA never fights hash routing.

contentArchetype: A build-your-own product configurator wrapped in a storefront: hero promise ('Boba, built your way.'), a four-group single-select builder with live derived name/description/price, a six-item priced favorites menu as the escape hatch for non-builders, a six-day city route timetable, and a one-line contact footer. Fits any customize-then-buy surface — sandwich builders, plan pickers, PC configurators, bouquet builders — anywhere the configurator, not the catalog, is the hero.
remix: The load-bearing moves: (1) ONE tri-stop pastel page gradient plus white-bordered frosted cards — the glass only reads because the wash behind it is saturated; (2) a single accent gradient worn by every selected/priced/actionable thing so 'chosen' and 'costs money' share a color; (3) 999px pills for anything tappable, 16–26px radii for anything that holds content; (4) derived state from one selection object with a single shared price function — summary card, button label, and agent bridge can never disagree; (5) blob-morph keyframes on decorative shapes only, never on content. Re-skin by rotating the three page-gradient stops and the two accent stops together (mint→lilac→lemon with a teal→blue accent reads spa; peach→rose→sky with sunset stops reads smoothie bar). Blend toward 'gradient' (fieldwork) by cooling the stops and letting glass carry more structure; toward a dark Y2K by flipping the wash to deep purple and cranking the blob opacity. Drop the blobs first for a calmer read — the pills and the gradient accent alone still say bubble tea.
